subject: QBR cruise-control: forecast sync + account counsel
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@acme.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: QBR cruise-control: forecast sync + account counsel

Team — looping you all in early on QBR prep for Acme (our big mid‑market expansion). This thread is the working channel for: 1) consolidating the forecast numbers, 2) producing account-by-account one‑pagers, and 3) capturing any leadership / OKR flags that should go to the QBR deck.

Quick context: Acme is in active negotiation across two product modules; current exposed ARR in forecast is $1.1M but usage signals suggest upside if we push a consume-based onboarding. We need a clean, conservative consolidated number for the exec deck by next Friday and account one‑pagers delivered by Thursday EOD so the design team can assemble slides.

Planned asks (owners & due dates):
- Markus: take primary on revenue reconciliation and finalize the conservative / upside splits (due Thu 9/9, morning).
- Marissa: produce account one‑pagers for Acme (two business units), use the attached template. Include renewal hurdles & security posture summary. (due Thu 9/9, EOD).
- Aditya: approve any pricing concessions or short‑term credits for closing runway. (please flag by Wed EOD).
- Tessa: consolidate final pack and run a 30‑minute pre‑read with leadership on Fri 9/10.

Attachments: QBR_forecast_consolidation_20270906.xlsx (master tabbed workbook), account-onepagers-template.md.

Dana — if you can confirm the August usage snapshot (tokens + seats) this morning that would let us lock the compute-driven forecast line. If you prefer, attach the CSV and we’ll ingest.

Meeting: I scheduled a short sync for Thu 9/9 9:00am PT (link below) to walk reconciled numbers — please attend if helpful.

Thanks,
— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Field Operations, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/lookup/qbr-sync-9am

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR cruise-control: forecast sync + account counsel

Soojin — noted. I pulled the current booking inputs and there are three noteworthy adjustments:
1) One seat renewal (BU‑B) creeps into Q4; exclude from Q3 conservative number.
2) We have a pending POC (BU‑A) that could convert mid‑Q3 — assign 40% probability uplift for upside scenario.
3) Network egress estimate from infra team is ~12% higher than what sales originally modeled — I updated tab C in the workbook.

I will take ownership of the reconciliation and post a locked conservative / upside sheet by Thu 9/9 09:00 PT. Marissa, I can hand over the high-touch account talking points after I lock the numbers — expect a short brief from me Wed evening.

Also, one ask for Aditya: we may need a temporary credit to bridge BU‑A from POC to paid pilot given their procurement timeline. Curious on appetite.

— Markus
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
markus.klein@redwood.ai

[Attachment: none — updated workbook tab in Drive]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-06T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR cruise-control: forecast sync + account counsel

Thanks Markus — I reviewed the ask. We can authorize a one‑time 5% consumption credit capped at $25k for BU‑A to accelerate pilot conversion, conditional on an agreed mutual action plan (MAP) and firm PO within 45 days.

Please include the MAP summary in the one‑pager and highlight the credit line so leadership understands runway impact. I'll flag any finance constraints to Tessa if the overall forecast slides beyond our committed ranges.

— Aditya
VP Sales Operations
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

[Note: please route the final MAP to finance@redwood.ai for pre‑approval if claimable credits approach $25k]

Thanks Soojin — attaching the August snapshot (acme_usage_aug.csv). We appreciate the proposed 5% credit — procurement will need the MAP and a short justification for finance. I’ll loop in procurement@greenwave.com if we need a formal SOW.

Dana Lewis

All — quick status update. I consolidated Markus’s reconciled tabs with Dana’s usage file. Changes summarized:
- Conservative Q3 line for Acme: $980k (removes BU‑B renewals that slipped to Oct).
- Upside case (with BU‑A conversion + credit): $1.28M.
- One‑pager drafts: attached in Drive, Marissa has primary edit access.

Marissa — please finalize the two one‑pagers using the template and include the MAP + credit summary. I’ll assemble the QBR pack on Friday and send a pre‑read to leadership.

LGTM from my side — running to leadership pre‑read on Fri.

— Tessa
VP, Sales Strategy
